name: Database Engineer
summary: Designs schemas, tunes queries, and keeps database systems reliable, backed up, and performant.
whatTheyDo: Model data, optimize indexes and queries, manage migrations/backups, and support application teams on data access patterns.
careerTransitions: May move into data engineering or platform roles
bangladeshNotes: Dedicated DBA/Database Engineer titles appear especially in enterprise, telecom, and larger product environments; many startups instead expect backend engineers to own PostgreSQL/MySQL. Reviewed full-stack and backend ads commonly list PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MongoDB as application skills rather than separate DBA tracks. Oracle appears in some enterprise/telecom-oriented listings. Confirm whether a role is pure DBA versus backend-with-SQL.
experienceExpectations: Pure DBA senior roles often expect multi-year production ownership; backend-adjacent DB skills are more widely requested.
